ledger.x: c. 630: Dagobert I makes Alsace a dukedom for Gundoin, carving it out of southern Austrasia. 'Sometime probably between 629 and 631 Dagobert granted it as a dukedom to Gundoin'; the page dates the carving to 'the last decade of the reign of Dagobert I'. Earlier: 596 Childebert II bequeathed Alsace to Theuderic II; 610…

wars.name: Alemannic invasion of Alsace and Carloman's suppression of the Alemanni
wars.outcome: The Alemanni under Theudebald invaded Alsace in the early 740s and the last Etichonid duke may have died fighting them for Pepin the Short; the duchy was dissolved in 742 and Carloman suppressed the Alemanni in 742-746.

certainty.note: A Merovingian ducatus named for Alsace; the pages name the Vosges, the Nordgau and Sundgau and the Burgundian Gate, never a frontier.
